name: JudgeBiasBench
description: JudgeBiasBench is a benchmark designed to systematically quantify biases in large language model-based judges. It defines a taxonomy of judgment biases across four dimensions and constructs bias-augmented evaluation instances covering 12 representative bias types to evaluate generative and discriminative judges.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark with limited but growing use in papers studying LLM-as-a-judge reliability and bias.
notes: Constructs bias-augmented evaluation instances through controlled bias injection; covers 12 bias types; evaluates both generative and discriminative judges; proposes bias-aware training methods.
